params.2095: Special: No More Nomad... No More!
params.2184:
For most warriors, fighting Nomad was difficult enough once, so this is one of the most difficult (one-off) battles. It's a real test of skill to beat him twice in a row without a chance to recuperate.

Combat: You will be pitched against Nomad twice in a row without the option of replenishing your inventory for food or for taking a breather. The rules will be the same as in a normal battle with no handicaps.

Quests required to play: Nomad's Requiem.
